title: Vermont completes light blue while Beta has auction cash
description: Vermont completes light blue while Beta has auction cash. Buying Vermont completes a cheap high-tempo set; auctioning lets cash-rich Beta steal it. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: Buying completes my Light Blue monopoly (Oriental, Connecticut, Vermont). Cost $100, leaving $320 cash, enabling future house building and rent increase. No reason to auction.
